os.build_lab_note: BuildLabEx and CurrentBuild differ. Both strings were read. This stage does not reconcile them.

administrators_token.value: BUILTIN\Administrators present as Group used for deny only

elevation.reason: Medium integrity together with the deny-only Administrators group on this token.

account_can_elevate_via_uac.reason: Elevation was not requested and was not tested.

process.other_privileges_reason: whoami /priv was filtered to the named list so the artifact would not dump the whole token.

hypervisor_identity.reason: The boolean does not name the hypervisor. No hypervisor management command was run.

slat_wmi.interpretation: Raw WMI value only. Not treated as proof that SLAT is absent or that VM creation is blocked.

vm_monitor_mode_extensions_wmi.interpretation: Raw WMI value only. Not treated as a capability conclusion.

lxss_manager.note: Older service name. Absence does not by itself mean WSL is absent.

wsl_service.note: Queried once. Case variants resolve to the same service.

wsl_exe_at_system32.note: File presence only. wsl.exe was not executed.

vboxmanage_default_path.note: Default path only. Other install locations were not searched.

vmware_workstation_default_path.note: Default path only. Other install locations were not searched.

virtualization.features_enabled_limit: Hyper-V management and host-compute services are running, and WslService is running. That is not a disposable guest, a mount policy, or an isolation proof.

protected_execution_boundary_already_pre.reason: No AppContainer, restricted token, separate user, or protected acquisition directory was observed.
